info.title: Mobula API
info.description: Onchain trading backend for trading apps, bots, and traders. Swap routing and execution across 90+ EVM chains and Solana (Uniswap v2/v3/v4, PancakeSwap, SushiSwap, Curve, Raydium, Jupiter) plus launchpad and bonding-curve coverage (PumpFun, Meteora, Raydium Launchlab, FourMeme). Cross-chain bridging through Mobula's own router. Real-time and historical market data: token prices, OHLCV candles, DEX trades, holder and trader analytics, wallet portfolios with PnL, DeFi position tracking, on-chain wallet labels, and token security audits. Live Pulse feed of new token launches and trending pairs. Official SDK: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@mobula_labs/sdk | TypeScript types: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@mobula_labs/types | Open-source trading terminal: https://mtt.gg (source: https://github.com/MobulaFi/MTT).
info.guidance:
Mobula is a REST API for real-time and historical crypto data across 90+ blockchains. It covers token analytics, wallet portfolios, DEX trades, DeFi positions, security audits, swap execution, on-chain wallet labels, and launchpad data including PumpFun, Meteora, and Raydium Launchlab bonding-curve pools. The /market/lighthouse endpoint provides a real-time Pulse feed of new token launches, trending pairs, and market-wide activity.

Agentic payments (no human in the loop): Mobula exposes the same agent product on two rails — /agent/x402/... (USDC on Base or Solana, x402 payment headers) and /agent/mpp/... (Tempo / MPP credentials). Replace the prefix only: e.g. /agent/x402/subscribe and /agent/mpp/subscribe are equivalent flows with different settlement. Workflow: 1) Call .../subscription to check for an existing plan. 2) If none, call .../subscribe with plan and payment_frequency (402 then pay). 3) Use the returned API key with "x-api-key: <key>" or "Authorization: <key>" on any REST endpoint — no per-call agent payment for data. 4) WebSocket streams at wss://streams.mobula.io with the same API key. 5) Monitor credits via .../subscription and top up via .../top-up. Fully autonomous.

Authentication: pass your API key via header "Authorization: <key>" or "x-api-key: <key>" or query param "?apiKey=<key>". Without an API key, endpoints use MPP payment: first request returns 402, pay via MPP (USDC), then retry the same request for a 200 response.

Blockchain identifiers: use the numeric chain ID for EVM chains (1 = Ethereum, 56 = BSC, 137 = Polygon, 8453 = Base, 42161 = Arbitrum, 43114 = Avalanche, 10 = Optimism). Chain names also work: "ethereum", "base", "arbitrum", "polygon", "bsc", "avalanche", "optimism". For Solana use "solana" or "solana:solana". Non-EVM chains: "alephium", "supra", "lighter".

Key patterns: tokens are identified by contract address + blockchain. Wallets are identified by address. Pools by pool contract address + blockchain. Most GET endpoints have a POST batch variant accepting an array of items (up to 500) for bulk lookups.

Documentation & SDKs: Full API documentation: https://docs.mobula.io. Official TypeScript/JS SDK: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@mobula_labs/sdk. Shared TypeScript types: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@mobula_labs/types. Open-source trading terminal built on the SDK: https://mtt.gg (source: https://github.com/MobulaFi/MTT).

Browse the paths below and their x-agent-guidance for per-endpoint usage, input modes, and response details.

get.description: Performs a fast fuzzy search across all indexed tokens, DEX pools, and wallets. Matches against token name, symbol, contract address, pool pair name, wallet address, and stored name/symbol translations for non-latin-named tokens (e.g. "Niu" finds 牛来). Returns ranked results with logo URLs, chain info, market cap, and relevance score. Use for building search bars, token pickers, or address resolution in agent workflows.
